turing_hall.name: Turing Hall
turing_hall.blurb: Big lecture halls for Intro to Programming, where Day Jay is the TA. Hallways lined with numbered lockers.

ta_office.name: TA office hours room
ta_office.blurb: A small, very tidy room in Turing Hall with a whiteboard.

hopper_lab.name: Hopper Computer Lab
hopper_lab.blurb: Rows of humming machines, flickering lights, always open. Ciel practically lives here at 2 a.m.

cs_rooftop.name: CS building rooftop
cs_rooftop.blurb: Reached through a fire door at the top of the lab stairwell. Quiet, cold, with a view of the sunrise.

capstone_room.name: Capstone team room
capstone_room.blurb: A glass-walled project room with a big screen for code review.

exam_hall.name: Exam hall
exam_hall.blurb: Rows of single desks, a big clock on the wall. Used for midterms and finals week.

tutoring_center.name: Tutoring center
tutoring_center.blurb: Couches, snacks, and a whiteboard covered in other people's handwriting. Monty volunteers here.

lovelace_library.name: Lovelace Library
lovelace_library.blurb: Tall shelves, reading lamps, and a card catalog nobody uses but Monty.

university_archive.name: University Archive (Sun Wing)
university_archive.blurb: Dusty records and old portraits of the Sun household, which the Oracle family later absorbed. Julian has a key.

council_room.name: Student council room
council_room.blurb: Labeled folders, two coffee mugs, a very large binder. Julian is always here.

server_room.name: Council server room
server_room.blurb: Ancient, humming servers that have run campus systems forever.

oracle_great_hall.name: Oracle Great Hall
oracle_great_hall.blurb: The formal ballroom, donated by the Oracle family. Chandeliers and a long guest list.

hackathon_hall.name: Student union hackathon hall
hackathon_hall.blurb: A big open room with power strips everywhere, pizza boxes, and LED strips. Doubles as the makerspace.

union_rooftop.name: Student union rooftop
union_rooftop.blurb: String lights, a couple of beat-up beanbags, and the best sunset on campus.

game_dev_club_room.name: Game dev club room
game_dev_club_room.blurb: A cramped room off the union with old consoles and a whiteboard of engine diagrams. Not officially a club. Ciel runs it from the shadows.

union_arcade.name: Union arcade
union_arcade.blurb: The union basement. Old arcade machines with strange rules and a scoreboard that adds wrong.

the_stack.name: The Stack (dining hall)
the_stack.blurb: A big, loud dining hall with a stack of trays at the door and a long lunch line.

cafe_cache.name: Café Cache
cafe_cache.blurb: The campus coffee shop, with a bubble tea counter in the back for Jay. Home of the coffee appreciation society.

bookstore.name: Campus bookstore
bookstore.blurb: Textbooks, hoodies, and a wall of laptop stickers.

main_quad.name: Main quad
main_quad.blurb: The center of campus, with a fountain and benches.

fountain_bench.name: Quad fountain bench
fountain_bench.blurb: A stone bench by the quad fountain. A good place to sit and think.

festival_stage.name: End-of-term festival stage
festival_stage.blurb: A temporary stage on the main quad, built in week 14, that runs on the site Jay built.

greenhouse.name: Greenhouse
greenhouse.blurb: Warm, humid, full of labeled plant pots. The gardening club's home. Its lights stay on during the end-of-term festival.

campus_garden.name: Campus garden and hedge maze
campus_garden.blurb: Winding paths next to the greenhouse, with a small hedge maze at the center.

picnic_lawn.name: Picnic lawn
picnic_lawn.blurb: A sunny hill behind the library.

duck_pond.name: Duck pond
duck_pond.blurb: A small pond by the garden. Quack has opinions about the real ducks.

observatory.name: Observatory
observatory.blurb: A small dome on the hill at the edge of campus, open for stargazing nights.

fitness_center.name: Fitness center (gym)
fitness_center.blurb: Weights, mirrors, and a lot of people counting reps.

running_track.name: Running track
running_track.blurb: A loop around the athletic field. Everyone is counting laps.

babbage_hall.name: Babbage Hall (dorm)
babbage_hall.blurb: Her room, a shared common room, and the laundry room whose schedule Monty scripted. Where Quack talks to her each night.

laundry_room.name: Babbage Hall laundry room
laundry_room.blurb: Four washers and a schedule on the wall that Monty scripted. It actually works.
